name: XlConditionValueTypes
description: Specifies the types of condition values that can be used.

constants.name: xlConditionValueLowestValue
constants.description: Lowest value from the list of values.

constants.name: xlConditionValueHighestValue
constants.description: Highest value from the list of values.

constants.name: xlConditionValueAutomaticMin
constants.description: The shortest data bar is proportional to the minimum value in the range.

constants.name: xlConditionValueAutomaticMax
constants.description: The longest data bar is proportional to the maximum value in the range.
